items.title: Ray Shiner interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 11, 1998
items.q: Jack End had a band. Jack was a clarinet teacher and he played in the Rochester Philharmonic, which eventually I played in

ctx.x: Now did they have any involvement in jazz at all at that time?

It was unofficial. Jack End had a band. Jack was a clarinet teacher and he played in the Rochester Philharmonic, which eventually I played in, as an English horn and oboe player. Well I was alto sax soloist with the orchestra my first record date, which was very funny.
